definition: Tidewater Georgian, offered as the place to begin: a variant of Georgian Colonial American, the first style the corpus filled end to end, read whole in its dossier, with an example brief to compose a house from.
basis: Editorial. Which style is offered as the guided example is the workbench's own choice for Phase 14, and no corpus file names one; what the style is, is the corpus's. README.md: "Georgian Colonial is filled end to end" as its depth-first proof, and "Tidewater Georgian is then written as a" short override of it, "each resolving the rest from the parent". The example brief is briefs/family-georgian.json, the one docs/compose.md runs first.
